eligible_inventory.normalized_fact: NVIDIA GTC Berlin -- qBraid today introduced qBraid OS, software that quantum hardware providers and system operators can use to run their systems and make them available to users, whether as a commercial service or for internal use. qBraid OS manages access, scheduling and billing for a quantum processor, and runs it together with NVIDIA accelerated computing, on premises or in the cloud。
